newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland's Spring lauds Hebron deal.
newsitem.headline: Ireland's Spring lauds Hebron deal.

text.p: Irish Foreign Minister Dick Spring, a member of the EU's fact-finding Middle East "troika," said on Wednesday that the Israeli-Palestinian Hebron agreement was a major step towards implementing the Oslo peace accords.

"I sincerely hope that it will help Israelis and Palestinians re-establish the trust and cooperation that are necessary to strengthen and further advance the implementation of their peace agreements," he said in a statement.
Spring has visited the region several times, including a trip last year when Ireland held the EU presidency, to secure a bigger role for the 15-nation bloc in overseeing peace efforts.
